description:
We are currently sold-out of medium frames.
The Bacchetta Giro 26 Evo is built for the long haul. 26” wheels soak up the road and a top-end component package assures that you will be riding for miles and miles. Whether planning a tour across the country or enjoying a day ride with friends, the Bacchetta Giro 26 Evo will ensure that you get there fast and in comfort.
The new Giro 26 Evo builds on the Giro’s legendary versatility with the Adroit2 dropout system. This versatile road bike is now disk-brake-specific featuring internal cable routing, an oversized head tube to accomodate modern forks with a tapered steerer tube (for more strength and better handling) and thru axles. Finally, the geometry has been optimized to accomodate 40mm wide tires for use in all riding conditions (50mm shown in picture with additional spacer on the idler).
This bike features top-notch components including Velocity USA’s Aileron handbuilt wheelset, a variety of top-notch drivetrain options, and TRP Spyke brakes for exceptional stopping power. Choose your seat - for those that want comfort in the most upright position, choose the classic Recurve seat. If you want to recline a little more and save 2.5 pounds at the same time, the new B3 seat will work perfectly for you. If you want even more recline, choose the Euromesh seat with your choice of seat pad.
If you are looking for this bike with electric assist, check out the Bacchetta Pronto Alto!
Bacchetta bikes can be loaded up with a variety of accessories to meet your riding needs. Carry up to four panniers with the Universal Rear Rack and/or the Terracycle EasyReacher under seat rack. Kickstands, fenders and mirrors are readily available. And for shorter, day rides, Bacchetta offers a variety of bags.
We charge a flat rate of $369 for shipping via freight in the Continental US. UPS shipping to Hawaii and Alaska is also $369, but the bike is not fully assembled. Shipping to Canada is a flat $629, but does not include any duty and fees you may be charged.
The bike comes 99% fully assembled (Hawaii, Alaska and International excluded) - just install the front wheel and adjust the seat/handlebars to your liking. If you order additional parts with the bike, our website may charge you additional shipping.
A final note about ordering bikes on our website: We will always call you after you place your order to discuss your build, make sure all of the options are correct and ensure that it is the right bike for you. If we need to make changes, additions or cancellations, we will happily do that - we want to make sure you are happy with your new bike. We will NEVER just ship out a bike without a conversation. To check to see if you have a local dealer, check out our Bacchetta Dealer Locator page.
